About Decathlon Sports India

Decathlon is a globally recognized sporting goods retailer known for designing, manufacturing, and selling sports equipment and apparel across categories ranging from running and cycling to team and racket sports. In India, Decathlon operates stores and digital channels focused on making sports accessible and sustainable for everyday players.

Interning at Decathlon Sports India Private Limited is valued by students interested in retail management, customer experience, and sports communities. Team members regularly connect customers with the right gear, support local sporting activities, and work across physical stores and digital touchpoints.

Decathlon Internship 2027: Key Highlights

Role and Responsibilities of Decathlon Internship

As an Omni Sport Advisor Intern, you work across Decathlon’s in-store and digital channels to help customers pick suitable sports gear and services. Key responsibilities for roles of this type at Decathlon include:

  • Deliver Customer Experience: Greet visitors, understand their sporting needs, and recommend appropriate products and services (such as repairs, maintenance, or personalization) across store, web, and app channels.
  • Build Sports Communities: Share information on local sporting activities or store events and encourage customers to stay active in their favorite sports.
  • Maintain Store & Inventory Readiness: Help keep product displays organized, safe, and welcoming while supporting accurate inventory availability for omnichannel orders.
  • Collaborate on Retail Operations: Coordinate with store teammates to ensure smooth floor operations and responsive customer service.

Eligibility Criteria of Decathlon Internship

Because specific internship batch rules on Internshala can vary by listing, verify your eligibility against the job notice before applying:

  • Who Can Apply: Students and early-career candidates with a passion for sports, active participation in physical or sporting activities, and strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Educational Background: Students or graduates interested in business, management, retail, or sports-related fields often find strong alignment, though specific degree or academic year rules are governed by the official listing.
  • Location Requirement: Availability to work in Bangalore for the duration of the internship.
  • Age Limit & Seats: No specific minimum or maximum age limit is stated in the provided details, and exact seat numbers are not publicly disclosed.

Stipend and Internship Benefits

  • Monthly Stipend: Rs.12,000 per month as highlighted for this listing.
  • Practical Retail & Omnichannel Exposure: Experience working in a fast-paced sports retail environment that connects physical stores with digital shopping.
  • Sports & Team Culture: Work alongside sports-enthusiastic colleagues and engage with local athletic communities.
  • Certificate & Skill Growth: Build customer service, communication, and retail operations skills upon completing the internship.
